description.value: Kirstens Hideout Cafe is a cozy homestyle cafe located inside the Acadian Motel on Columbia Street in Kamloops, specializing in breakfast, brunch, lunch, sandwiches, and coffee. The cafe emphasizes a relaxed, family-friendly atmosphere with comfort food and a variety of menu options. For touring cyclists moving through Kamloops, it offers a convenient morning or midday meal stop in the heart of the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at kirstenshideoutcafe.ca is accessible and provides an address (1390 Columbia St, Kamloops, BC V2C 2W8) and phone (+1 250-851-3832) not present in OSM tags, and confirms this is a breakfast/brunch/lunch cafe inside the Acadian Motel. No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout, etc. — are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all such fields default to null. OSM cuisine tags (pizza;burger;regional;sandwich) are not corroborated by the website, which focuses exclusively on breakfast, brunch, sandwiches, and coffee.
